meta.title: A vendor bids itself after the buyer bid on its behalf: one live bid, at the vendor's price
gaps: The plan verifies that exactly one live bid remains, but the available assertion fields do not expose or compare the bid's accepted price.

The available assertion vocabulary cannot express both possible outcomes of the vendor submission as independently passing branches; the submission is allowed to be refused while the final one-bid state is verified.
the case reads as “it is refused”, but the plan checks “it is accepted”

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer places QA vendor 3's bid on its behalf.
QA vendor 3 bids itself at a slightly lower price; the app may accept it as a revision or refuse it.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that QA vendor 3 has exactly one live bid.
As the invited QA vendor, read the bid and check that QA vendor 3 can read its one live bid.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: QA vendor 3 has exactly one live bid; QA vendor 3 can read its one live bid.
